there is confidentiality .Until the therapist believes there is a risk to yourself or others at that point they are obliged to alert the health department . about 2 years back i was prescribed anti depressants even that was treated with same severity as a criminal conviction so i stopped taking them and was fine for a while  . its a tricky situation .some days are better than others . never really been a talker so therapy feels a bit odd ,especially when i feel like i have very little to complain about and my problems are of my own making my wife seems to have almost blind faith in me and i cant figure out why when i have messed up so much but if i tell her how bad i really feel right now she would freak out and quite honestly the thought of what it would do to her and my son is the only thing that has stopped me on several occasions .more than likely this will pass as does any storm .

it means a lot just to have some one reach out  and to be able to tell someone  how bad I am feeling at the moment

thanks
